title: Muhajir vs Ansar: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Ek ne Makkah se sab kuch chhod kar hijrat ki... lekin doosre ne kya diya? Muhajir Makkah se Madina Hijrat karne wale Sahaba hain jinhone apna ghar bar qurban kiya. Jabke Ansar Madina ke muqami Sahaba hain jinhone hijrat karne walon ko apna adha maal diya. Muhajir qurbani dene wale hain, jabke Ansar madad karne wale. Aise hi Islamic comparisons ke liye follow karein.
hook_variants: Ek ne Makkah se sab kuch chhod kar hijrat ki... lekin doosre ne kya diya?
Kya aapko Muhajir aur Ansar mein farq pata hai?
Muhajir aur Ansar ko ek samajhne ki ghalti mat karein!
